title: CLO 2026.0 - CLO-SET
description: CLO 2026.0 version has been officially released — Make it, for real! CLO technical experts provide a detailed explanation of the CLO-SET related updates: now files can be saved directly from CLO to CLO-SET, along with the introduction of new Content and Studio pages.
transcript:
In the previous version, if you wanted to share fabric or fabric documents to Closet, you needed to save them to the computer and then upload them through the browser.  
Starting from version 2026.0, you can complete the upload of the fabric and simplify the entire process.  
First, let's try to upload the fabric applied on the clothing to the object window.  
In the fabric options card, select the fabric you want to upload.  
After selecting, look at the property editor at the bottom.  
At the top right of the property editor, you will find the newly added Closet icon.  
Clicking on the icon will display two options: new content and new version.  
If this is your first time uploading assets to Closet, please select new content.  
If you want to upload a modified version of an existing file to Closet, please select new version.  
For example, if you want to upload a new asset, select new content.  
Set the preview image in the saved fabric window.  
After clicking the confirm button, you will immediately be redirected to the upload page of the related Closet account.  
Complete the quick and simple upload.  
In addition to fabric,  
you can also upload photos, buttons, buttonholes, eyes, name lines, seamstress spells,  
attachments, and zippers directly to Closet.  
But please note that for seamstress spells,  
only the new content option is currently supported.  
It is not currently possible to update them as a new version.  
Through the upload file function,  
you can manage and share fabric and fabric resources more efficiently.  
Enjoy an unlimited cooperative experience.  
In order to continuously optimize the Closet user experience,  
we have updated the content page and workspace interface of Closet.  
When a 3D file is uploaded to Closet,  
users will first see the cover section.  
You can fill in the main information in the lower section,  
for example, classification.  
You can also add labels.  
By clicking the settings button in the upper right corner,  
you can define the content displayed on the first page.  
You can drag and drop or delete the displayed content.  
You can also check other detailed information on the labels page above,  
for example, details, versions, linked content, etc.  
The next part is the viewfinder.  
We have made some changes to the 3D viewfinder.  
Click on the label in the upper right corner.  
You can see the logo and color of the file.  
Click on the upper left column.  
You can manage the version.  
The next part is the material list.  
It will display the material information according to the Closet settings.  
Click on each part of the table in the material list.  
You can edit the data of each material.  
You can also click on add empty line.  
Here is the newly created material in Closet.  
The material list is next to the measurement line POM.  
It will display the measurement point data according to the Closet settings.  
You can see the measurement line in the 3D viewfinder window on the right.  
You can see the measurement point data in the 3D viewfinder window on the right.  
You can upload other relevant articles on the attachments page.  
You can upload other relevant articles on the attachments page.  
Your students will be able to edit other relevant articles.  
Thank you.  
Finally, you can see the file creation cycle.  
Click on the share icon in the upper right column.  
You can share your website.  
You can post comments.  
You can click on the user's avatar to switch to dark mode.  
Go back to the Workroom page, click on the information button at the bottom, and you can see the relevant information of the file.  
Through the above updates, users can design and develop more smoothly.

chunks.content: ## CLO 2026.0 - CLO-SET Fabric and Asset Upload Enhancements This section explains the new fabric and asset upload process introduced in CLO 2026.0, including how to upload fabrics and other related assets directly to Closet, streamlining asset management and collaboration. Starting from CLO version 2026.0, the process of uploading fabrics and related assets to Closet has been significantly simplified. Previously, users had to save fabric or fabric documents locally and upload them via a browser. Now, uploads can be completed directly from CLO’s interface. ### Uploading Fabrics to Closet - In the Object window, select the fabric applied to the clothing. - Open the Fabric Options card and select the desired fabric. - In the Property Editor (bottom panel), locate the new Closet icon at the top right. - Clicking the Closet icon presents two options: - **New Content:** Use this for the first-time upload of a fabric or asset. - **New Version:** Use this to upload a modified version of an existing asset. - Select the appropriate option based on your upload type. - Set a preview image in the saved fabric window. - Confirm to be redirected to the Closet upload page to complete the process. ### Supported Asset Types Besides fabrics, CLO 2026.0 supports direct upload of the following asset types to Closet: - Photos - Buttons - Buttonholes - Eyes - Name lines - Seamstress spells (Note: only new content upload is supported; version updates are not available) - Attachments - Zippers This feature enhances resource management and sharing capabilities, enabling unlimited cooperative workflows. --- ## Updated Closet User Interface and Content Management This section covers the updates to the Closet content page and workspace interface designed to improve the user experience when managing 3D files and associated materials. ### Content Page Structure When a 3D file is uploaded to Closet, the user sees a structured content page divided into several sections: - **Cover Section:** Displays a cover image or preview. - **Main Information:** Located below the cover, users can fill in metadata such as classification and labels. - **Settings Button:** Positioned at the upper right, it allows customization of displayed content on the first page. Users can drag, drop, or delete elements as needed. - **Labels Page:** Provides access to detailed information like asset details, version history, and linked content. ### 3D Viewfinder Enhancements The 3D viewfinder has been updated for better file visualization and management: - Clicking the label in the upper right reveals the file’s logo and color. - The upper left column allows version management. - Measurement points and lines (POM) appear in the 3D viewfinder window on the right, reflecting Closet settings. ### Material List and Editing - The material list displays according to Closet’s configuration. - Clicking any table part lets users edit material data. - An **Add Empty Line** option enables adding new materials directly in Closet. ### Attachments Management - Users can upload and manage relevant articles or supplementary assets on the attachments page.

The updated Closet interface offers enhanced content management, including metadata editing, version control, material list customization, and improved 3D viewfinder functionality. Additional features like file sharing, commenting, and workspace navigation improve collaborative design processes.
